name: Wake Me Up: Move & Rise
subtitle: Alarms with a little sunshine
promotionalText: Wake to original music, move at your own pace, and collect a little sunrise. Seven challenges. No login. A warmer way to start your day.
description:
Bring your sunshine back, one small move at a time.

Wake Me Up turns your morning alarm into a warm, achievable ritual. Choose a movement, pick an original ringtone, and watch your little sun rise as you make progress.

SEVEN WAYS TO START
• Push-ups with guided counting or optional on-device camera counting
• Squats at your own pace
• A short dance with optional motion sensing
• Marching on the spot
• A gentle seated stretch
• Paced breathing
• Follow the Sun, a playful focus-tapping challenge

YOUR ALARM, YOUR RHYTHM
Set your time and repeat days, name your alarm, and preview three original instrumental ringtones: First Light, Soft Start, and Rise and Shine. Native system alarms can ring while Wake Me Up is closed, with your permission.

A LITTLE SUNRISE EVERY DAY
Complete a real alarm ritual to save a sunrise, an optional mood, and your consecutive-day streak. Practice any standard challenge whenever you like. Practice does not add journal credit.

FREE FEELS COMPLETE
Two alarms, all seven challenges, three ringtones, optional camera and motion counting, your sunrise journal, and unlimited standard practice. No login. No ads.

WAKE ME UP PLUS
An optional monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription adds up to 20 alarms, adjustable challenge targets, and a longer dance practice. Prices appear in the app in your local currency. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple subscription settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Alarms, progress, and moods stay on your device. Optional camera frames and motion readings are processed on device and are never recorded or uploaded. No app account is required, including for Plus.

Designed for iPhone and iPad running iOS or iPadOS 26.1 or later. iOS always allows a system alarm to be dismissed; open Wake Me Up to complete the movement ritual. Choose a comfortable activity, use guided counting, or switch to a gentle alternative whenever you need.

reviewNotes:
No login or review account is required. The app uses native AlarmKit on iOS/iPadOS 26.1+. Please allow Alarms when saving an enabled alarm. Set an alarm a few minutes ahead, choose a challenge and ringtone, and wait for the system alert. The Start moving action opens the ritual. iOS retains its system Stop control; the app does not claim to prevent dismissal.

Every standard challenge is free. Use Move for immediate practice without waiting for an alarm. Push-ups support optional on-device Vision counting using the front camera, with guided manual counting available. Dance and marching support optional device-motion sensing; all permissions are optional. Gentle alternatives and exit controls remain accessible. Practice does not create journal credit. Actual completed alarms add one sunrise per alarm per day.

Plus monthly and yearly products provide the same entitlement: up to 20 alarms, customizable targets, and a longer dance practice. Purchase and Restore are under Settings > Explore Plus. No developer account is required; Apple manages purchases.

Camera frames and motion values are ephemeral and processed locally, with no recording, uploading, analytics, advertising, or tracking SDKs. The artwork was generated specifically for this app. The three original instrumental tracks were generated and officially downloaded with the developer's paid Suno plan; source details are retained in the project.
